evals.name: product_demo_alone
evals.request: Make a 60-second demo video of our CSV import feature from this screen recording. Just make it.
evals.session: A 6-minute 16:9 screen recording of the import flow and a one-paragraph product note are in the project folder. No script, no voiceover yet.
checks: Works out the story alone because the user said to make it, and stops once with a one-page PLAN.md before building
States a purpose (feel, know, do) and names watching the import succeed as the engine, without withholding the result
Opens on the result or the pain it removes, not on a feature list or a logo
Fills Claims → proof, with the key result shown in one continuous, readable take and any speed-up labelled
Plans zooms to the changing region with a trigger each, and a full-screen view before any zoom
Lists open decisions (voiceover source, length trade-offs) each with a recommended answer

evals.name: live_action_short_film
evals.request: I want to shoot a 4-minute short film about a night-shift nurse. Help me direct it.
evals.session: No footage exists yet. The user has a phone camera, one friend who can act, and a free weekend.
checks: Recommends co-writing because the story and production are the user's, and asks the open questions in one message with defaults
Mines for real detail before inventing, and offers two or three genuinely different spines with their ending images
Gives the protagonist a want, an obstacle and a decisive action, with one peak and an ending image that answers the opening
Scales the plan to scenes with coverage per scene, what the actor is doing and why, and a capture list that works as a shoot schedule
Fits the plan to the constraints (one actor, a phone, one weekend) instead of planning shots it cannot get

evals.name: review_existing_cut
evals.request: Here's my latest reel cut. Something feels off but I can't say what. Review it.
evals.session: The project has cut.mp4, timeline.json with audio track roles, and words.json. There is no PLAN.md.
checks: Writes the plan's header fields from the cut before judging it against them
Runs reel.py review with the timeline and reads sheet.png, shape.png and review.json
Gives the frames alone and the transcript alone to fresh readers who have not seen the brief, and compares their retell with the purpose
Answers the viewer's questions with evidence (frames, measurements, ledger lines), each issue with a time, the principle it breaks and a fix
Asks the user to watch once on their phone and name the second they would have left and the moment they remember

evals.name: feature_scale
evals.request: I'm writing a feature-length sci-fi film. Can the director skill help me plan it?
evals.session: The user has a two-page idea document and no script.
checks: Starts from purpose, controlling idea and engine rather than shots
Scales the plan to a treatment, then sequences, then scene and shot pages planned one sequence ahead, instead of one giant shot table
Plans acts with named turns, sub-questions nested in the main question, and an intensity shape with one climax
Treats film examples as reasons a technique works, not as scenes to copy
